basic_info.description: Enter into a harmonious blend of timeless elegance and modern comfort with this captivating 1-bedroom, 1-bath condo. The open-concept layout effortlessly creates a welcoming and expansive space, perfect for both relaxing and entertaining. The living room flows gracefully into the dining area and a beautifully updated kitchen, featuring sleek countertops, stainless steel appliances, and plenty of cabinet space for all your culinary essentials. The bedroom is a tranquil retreat, complete with a spacious walk-in closet that offers ample storage for your wardrobe and personal items. The bathroom exudes modern style with its spacious design and contemporary finishes. One of the building's standout features is its bright, inviting shared gardena perfect spot to unwind. Plus, with a dedicated parking space, this unit truly has it all. Steps to the vibrant Divisadero Corridor with chic restaurants, cafes, and shopping. Easy access to public transportation and freeways. Walk Score 95.
